summary: Full regression on the 3-step Apply form. All 9 backend pytest cases pass and the full frontend flow works: opaque Step-2 Select dropdown, City optional, Step 3 self-booking with 4 weekdays + 3 times, error toast for missing date/time, back buttons preserve values, and happy-path submit yielded apply-success + a lead with preferred_time='2:00 PM' via GET /api/leads.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _forward_to_webhook uses synchronous `requests` inside asyncio.to_thread which is fine, but a shared httpx.AsyncClient would be cleaner and avoid extra thread hop.
getBookingDays() iterates only i<=6; if week starts on Saturday it may return <4 weekdays. Consider i<=8 for safety.
Frontend axios call has no client-side email validation before POST; relies solely on server 422. Minor UX improvement.
form-back buttons restore state correctly (state is lifted), no issue.
seed_data_creation: Created 4 temp leads (qa-webhook-test, qa-webhook-nocity, qa-webhook-emptycity, qa-3step-test). All deleted post-run via pytest session fixture and manual mongo cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend schema: city optional, preferred_date/preferred_time strings; postal_code removed. test_leads_api.py updated accordingly. Live webhook is triggered on every POST — keep POSTs minimal and always clean up TEST_ leads by email. Dropdown opacity verified via computed background-color of [data-radix-select-viewport].parentElement — got rgb(11,11,15) which is opaque.
